intro: A heavy, lead-lined flask filled with irradiated radioactive fallout gathered from the troggs infesting Gnomeregan. The inventor Ozzie Togglevolt requested this hazardous sample in hopes of synthesizing a cure for irradiated leper gnomes—or perhaps concocting a dangerously potent rum.

p: The lead lining of this collection phial is essential to shield the carrier from the volatile green fallout saturating Gnomeregan. The fallout originated when High Tinker Mekkatorque's advisors flooded the lower corridors with toxic radiation to halt the invading troggs, a catastrophe that instead corrupted both troggs and surviving gnomes into maddened, irradiated horrors. By collecting fluid residue directly from Irradiated Invaders and Pillagers, daring adventurers furnish refugee tinkerers like Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos with raw materials needed to experiment on remedies.

related.n: The Only Cure is More Green Glow
